item.title: PyPI makes release attestations easier to find with new security tab
item.description: The Python Package Index (PyPI) has added a security tab to its project pages, giving developers a place to check where individual release files came from. How PyPI shows where release files came from The Security tab shows whether release files have digital attestations, which provide verifiable information about how a file was published or built. A release has full provenance when every file has at least one attestation.
